findings.title: Les hackers ont du sang sur les mains — Le Canard enchaîné
findings.summary_md: Le Canard enchaîné reported on 3 November 2026 that Coolworld, a maintenance provider for France’s Établissement français du sang, was breached overnight 1–2 November. Attackers reprogrammed cold-storage units from -30°C to 110°C, affecting blood samples and frozen plasma. The Ministry of Health stated zero operational impact after an on-call technician spotted the temperature rise.

findings.title: French blood storage units targeted in cyberattack — DataBreaches.Net
findings.summary_md: DataBreaches.Net published the incident on 3 November 2026, citing OMM reporting and Le Canard enchaîné. The attack targeted Coolworld-maintained cold-storage facilities for the French national blood service, with units programmed to reach 110°C. The incident occurred overnight Sunday to Monday (1–2 November) and was detected by an on-duty technician.
